fullDescription: Technical Noir global design system featuring a high-contrast dark mode aesthetic optimized for enterprise SaaS, technical dashboards, and data-heavy developer tools. Characterized by #020304 backgrounds, flat surfaces, razor-sharp 2-4px border radii, and a semantic color coding system (Cyan for Projects, Blue for Objects, Violet for Mapping). The layout utilizes a structured sidebar-to-content hierarchy with fixed navigation, monospace technical identifiers, and smooth View Transition API animations for a performant, application-like experience.
prompt:
## Resumo
A sophisticated technical dark-mode UI system called 'Technical Noir' designed for high-density information management. It uses a deep charcoal and black palette with vibrant semantic accents, geometric typography, and precise bordering to create a professional, low-light workspace for developers and technical administrators.

## Estilo Visual
Apply a 'Technical Noir' aesthetic: Background: #020304; Surface Primary: #0D1117; Surface Secondary: #111821; Border: #253142; Radius: 2-4px only. Typography: Headings in 'Space Grotesk' (600-700 weight, -0.05em tracking), Body in 'Work Sans' (400-600 weight). Semantic accents: Cyan #06b6d4 (primary action), Blue #2563eb (secondary items), Violet #A78BFA (mapping), Green #22C55E (success). Buttons: Flat with 2px radius, no heavy shadows. Inputs: bg-#111821 with 1px border. Transitions: Use View Transition API for page fades (0.25s ease-in/out) and hover states using bg-white/5% with transition-all 200ms.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Global Navigation Header
Height: 48px. Background: #0D1117. Border-bottom: 1px solid #253142. Sticky positioning. Elements: Brand logo (Cyan square icon + Space Grotesk text), centered or left-aligned horizontal nav links (font-size: 12px, font-weight: 500), and right-aligned user profile widget with a 32px square avatar placeholder.

### Project Sidebar
Width: 320px (large screens). Background: #111821. Border-right: 1px solid #253142. Top section: Search and filter icons in a 48px header. Middle: Scrollable list of cards. Card styling: #111821 base, 4px radius, 1px border #253142. Active card: 1px border #06b6d4 with a 4px wide vertical accent bar on the right. Content: Title (12px bold), Description (11px dim), metadata icons (layers, clock) at 10px.

### Main Content Header
Padding: 40px (large) / 24px (mobile). Elements: Breadcrumb (accent/text-dim), H1 Title (3xl, Space Grotesk), long-form description (14px, text-secondary, max-width 512px). Actions: Grouped on the right with primary (bg-accent) and secondary (bg-surface-secondary border-border) buttons.

### Stats Grid
Display: 3-column grid. Components: Stats cards with #111821 background, 1px border, 20px padding. Top row: Label (10px uppercase tracking-wider) + Icon. Middle row: Large value (3xl font-heading) + percentage indicator (10px). Bottom row: 4px height progress bar or small dot indicators for item statuses.

### Activity List
Container: bg-#0D1117, border-1px, divide-y-1px. Items: 16px padding, horizontal layout. Left: 32px square status icon with bg-accent/10. Center: Primary text (12px medium) + secondary metadata (10px dim). Right: Monospace status label (e.g., SUCCESS, WARNING).

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Status Dot Indicators — Visual representation of multiple object statuses within a single card.
Create a horizontal flex row with 8px spacing. Each item is an 8px circle or rounded square. Colors: bg-#22C55E for success, bg-#151D27 with border for empty/pending, bg-#A78BFA for in-progress. Use for quick status scanning.

### Technical Badge — Small labels for IDs, types, and categories.
Height: 18px. Padding: 0 6px. Background: bg-accent/10. Border: 1px solid bg-accent/20. Text: 9-10px bold uppercase. Color: match accent. Radii: 2px. Use for labels like 'MIGRATION' or 'ID: PRJ-001'.

style.description: The style is built on a foundation of 'Work Sans' for legibility and 'Space Grotesk' for high-impact headings. The color palette uses a dark base (#020304) with layered surfaces (#0D1117, #111821) and thin borders (#253142). It employs semantic functional colors: Cyan (#06b6d4) for core projects, Blue (#2563eb) for objects, and Green (#22C55E) for success states. Micro-interactions are subtle, using white/0.05 opacity overlays for hovers and the View Transition API for cross-page fading.
